title: 'The Murders in the Rue Morgue,' by Edgar Allen Poe, Part One (1/3)
titleZh: 愛倫坡《莫爾格街兇殺案》第一部分 (1/3)
summaryZh: 故事開場，敘事者在巴黎的舊書店結識了博學而清貧的青年杜邦。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — American Stories

sentences.text: The Murders in the Rue Morgue by Edgar Allan Poe Part 1 Paris
sentences.zh: 《莫爾格街兇殺案》，愛倫坡著，第一部分，巴黎

sentences.text: It was in Paris during the summer of 1840. There and then I met a strange and interesting young man named Auguste D
sentences.zh: 那是 1840 年夏天的巴黎。就在那個時候、那個地方，我認識了一位奇特又有趣的年輕人，名叫奧古斯特‧D

sentences.text: Dupin was the last member of a well-known family, a family that had once been rich and famous.
sentences.zh: 杜邦是一個名門世家的最後一位後代，那個家族曾經既富有又顯赫。

sentences.text: Auguste Dupin, however, was far from rich.
sentences.zh: 然而，奧古斯特‧杜邦一點也不有錢。

sentences.text: He had enough to buy necessities and a few books.
sentences.zh: 他的錢只夠買生活必需品和幾本書。

sentences.text: In fact, we first met in an old bookstore.
sentences.zh: 事實上，我們第一次見面就是在一家舊書店裡。

sentences.text: A few more chance meetings at such stores followed.
sentences.zh: 後來我們又在這類書店裡偶然遇到了幾次。
很快地，我們開始聊了起來。

sentences.text: I was deeply interested in the family history, he told me.
sentences.zh: 他跟我說了家族的歷史，我聽得非常入迷。

sentences.text: I was surprised, too, at how much and how widely he had read.
sentences.zh: 他讀過的書之多、涉獵之廣，也讓我很驚訝。

sentences.text: More important, the force of his busy mind was like a bright light in my soul.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，他那顆活躍腦袋的力量，像一道亮光照進我的心裡。

sentences.text: I felt that the friendship of such a man would be, for me, riches without price.
sentences.zh: 我覺得能和這樣的人做朋友，對我來說是無價之寶。
